product.title: Hiking to the Puerta del Cielo Viewpoint in Mexico City

description.text: A six-hour guided hike from Mexico City reaches the Puerta del Cielo viewpoint, with a ladder section, canyon overlooks, and a river-corridor return. Helmet, safety harness, bottled water, and park access fees are included. Stops include Fuente de Cibeles, Puerta del Cielo. The group meets at Fuente de Cibeles in Roma Norte beside the CDMX sign, then rides about 45 minutes to the trailhead. Ideal for visitors basing in Mexico City who want an intermediate highland hike without arranging trail transport or safety gear independently.

highlights: Guided hike to Puerta del Cielo from Mexico City
Small-group pacing with a local geology-minded guide
Return along a river corridor after the viewpoint
